findings.detail: Earlier question M2-S11-T1 covers the same idea in the same scenario: tracing callers of a helper through a wrapper module. Turning the fix ("which two steps") into a diagnosis ("which two flaws") would count as a different problem. However, the two correct answers mirror the earlier ones: identify all exported names from the module itself, and grep each name across the whole codebase. More than one wrong option also repeats. D repeats the earlier "search only for the original name, since wrapper calls still contain it". E repeats the earlier "read every file upfront". B repeats the earlier Glob-confusion distractor. At most one wrong option may repeat.

blind_answer.reason: Two flaws explain the missed callers. First, the exported names were taken from the README rather than from credibility_api.py itself, so two of the five exports were never searched. Second, Grep ran only in the synthesis folder, not across the whole codebase, so other callers (such as the web search subagent) were missed. Glob matches file paths, not file contents, so B is wrong. Callers of the wrapper use the wrapper's own names, not score_credibility, so D is wrong. Reading every file upfront is an anti-pattern, so E is wrong.
